name: Le Marais Heritage Walking Tour
accessibility_notes: Mostly flat paved streets; step-free; suitable for wheelchairs.
description: Small-group walk through the historic Marais led by neighbourhood guides, focusing on local artisans and heritage.

name: Seine Kayak & River Clean-up
accessibility_notes: Requires moderate mobility to enter/exit kayak; not wheelchair accessible.
description: Guided kayaking session combined with light litter collection along the Seine.

name: Organic Market Cooking Class
accessibility_notes: Step-free venue; accessible kitchen stations available on request.
description: Shop a local organic market then cook a seasonal French meal with a resident chef.

name: Street Art & History Bike Tour
accessibility_notes: Cycling tour; adapted/hand-cycles available with advance notice.
description: Locally guided bike tour covering Berlin's street-art scene and divided-city history.

name: Tempelhofer Feld Urban Nature Walk
accessibility_notes: Flat former runway; fully wheelchair accessible.
description: Self- or volunteer-guided walk across Berlin's iconic former airfield turned public park.

name: Refugee-led Kitchen Experience
description: Shared meal cooked and hosted by a refugee-led social enterprise supporting local integration.

name: Jordaan Canal Heritage Walk
accessibility_notes: Mostly flat; some cobblestones; largely wheelchair accessible.
description: Neighbourhood-led stroll through the Jordaan's canals, courtyards and independent shops.

name: Vondelpark & Urban Ecology Tour
description: Guided walk exploring the biodiversity and water management of Amsterdam's best-known park.

name: Repair Café Workshop
description: Hands-on session at a community repair café, learning to mend clothing and small electronics.

name: Nyhavn & Harbour Heritage Walk
description: Locally guided harbour walk covering Copenhagen's maritime heritage and green-harbour transformation.

name: Amager Nature Reserve Cycle
accessibility_notes: Cycling tour; adapted cycles available on request.
description: Guided ride through Amager's wetlands and meadows just minutes from the city centre.

name: Community Farm-to-Table Dinner
description: Seasonal communal dinner sourced from a local organic farm cooperative.
